messages:
maria_sales: FYI incoming RFP from NorthPeak. Big asks: on-prem HSM compatibility (they called out Thales Luna), short 2-week POC runbook we can execute, and a columnized pricing table for Dedicated vs Private. Need to pull a quick pricing delta + runbook sketch. Deadline Fri EOD.

 dan_se: I'll take the technical lead. Quick clarifying Q: do they require HSM-attested signing only, or do they want all keys to never leave HSM (no wrapping)?

 maria_sales: they wrote: "private HSM, keys must remain non-exportable; rotation via API is required." Also want audit log retention details and regional data residency (EU).

 ravi_ops: ack. For a 2-week POC with 50 TPS-ish token throughput peak, recommended Dedicated config: 3x A100-80GB (or equivalent T4s for cheaper perf). Rough calc: 3 GPUs * 48 hours peak = ~144 GPU-hours baseline, plus buffer -> ~220 GPU-hours. Private (onprem) has no infra fee but expect 2-4 days of integration ops and remote-support retainer. I'll produce a spreadsheet.

 sara_research: I'll prepare the capability matrix rows: HSM model compatibility, key lifecycle ops, supported quantizations, latency SLOs per model family, KV cache persistence options. Will mark any known limitations for Thales Luna if needed.

 nina_cs: they also want an itemized POC cost estimate (line items: infra, engineering support 40h, security review). Sales needs a number we can present.

 sec_bot: Security Q7: Can Redwood accept HSM attestation and provide SOC2 report redacted? Short answer: yes with NDA. I'll paste standard language for RFP.

 sec_bot: "Redwood supports integration with customer-managed HSMs (Thales, SafeNet, AWS CloudHSM) via PKCS#11 and KMIP. For private deployments we can configure connectors so key material never leaves the customer HSM. Detailed attestation docs and SOC2 excerpts available under NDA."

 dan_se: Proposed minimal POC acceptance tests: 1) network handshake with mutual TLS, 2) key generation on HSM, 3) verify non-exportability (attempt wrap => should fail), 4) rotation via API + verify new key used, 5) sample inference suite (5 low-latency prompts + 5 long generation stress tests), 6) audit log contains KMS events with timestamps.

 maria_sales: nice. Can you drop sample curl flows for the KMS flow and a short infra diagram stub? Ops needs it for integration estimate.

 dan_se: sample key flow (pseudo):
```
# create key on Thales (customer side)
curl -X POST https://thales.local/api/keys -H "Authorization: Bearer <token>" -d '{"alg":"rsa-2048","usage":"sign"}'

# Redwood call to sign using referenced key via connector
curl -X POST https://redwood-internal/api/v1/sign -H "X-Customer-Key: thales://key123" -d '{"payload":"abc"}'
```
Infra stub: VPN to customer VPC, connector VM in customer network, mutual TLS + PKI exchange.

 ravi_ops: uploaded cost calc: https://files.redwood.internal/attachments/np-costs-1759999991.csv (perm: sales,ops,se). Includes two scenarios: small Dedicated (3xA100) and Private (customer provided infra + 8h/day ops support).

 nina_cs: Good. For the RFP reply we'll present: 1) runbook PDF, 2) capability matrix CSV, 3) cost sheet CSV, 4) security Q&A snippet. I can bundle and upload to their portal.

 deploybot: created task list: https://tasks.redwood.internal/boards/np/1759999991 (tasks: runbook draft, cost calc, capability matrix, sec answers, bundle upload).

 sara_research: capability sample (inline):
"Feature | Hosted | Dedicated | Private | Notes"
"HSM Connect | connector (limited) | connector (full) | BYO HSM (PKCS#11) | Thales supported with driver"
"Quantization | q8_0 recommended | q8_0/q4_0 supported | depends on GPU | Private can tune per GPU"
"KV Cache | ephemeral by default | optional persistent | optional persistent | persistence requires storage config"

 dan_se: timeline: Wed AM initial runbook draft, Wed PM cost sheet, Thu morning capability matrix final, Thu afternoon bundle + legal sec signoff.

 maria_sales: risk callout: legal/attestation docs often need NDA & security time. If legal needs >48h, propose we send provisional RFP reply stating compliance options pending attestation.

 sec_bot: confirmed: we can provide provisional language. I'll queue the detailed checklist for review; expect comments by Thu noon if we expedite.

 nina_cs: I'll prep the portal bundle template and mark items that are NDA-gated.

 ravi_ops: volunteers for oncall during POC: ravi_ops primary, dan_se backup. We'll need escalation contacts.

 maria_sales: thanks all. I'll assemble a short email to NorthPeak after the runbook draft is in. Please flag PRs/edits in the runbook thread. :thumbsup: 

 (END)
